mapper.select: WITH items AS ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='SGA'),0) AS sga, COALESCE(sum(vat_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='SGA'),0) AS sga_vat, COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='NOPR_IN'),0) AS income, COALESCE(sum(vat_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='NOPR_IN'),0) AS income_vat, COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='NOPR_OUT'),0) AS expense, COALESCE(sum(vat_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} AND fin_cls_cd='NOPR_OUT'),0) AS expense_vat, COALESCE(sum(amt+vat_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_cls_cd IN ('SGA','NOPR_OUT') AND ((io_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) OR (io_dt IS NULL AND fin_ym=#{databaseMonth}))),0) AS cash_expense, COALESCE(sum(amt+vat_amt) FILTER(WHERE fin_cls_cd='NOPR_IN' AND io_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}),0) AS cash_income FROM tb_fi_item WHERE fin_ym=#{databaseMonth} OR io_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ), transfers AS ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE xfer_cls_cd='EXP'),0) AS expense, COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE xfer_cls_cd='SPCL'),0) AS labor, COALESCE(sum(amt),0) AS total FROM tb_fi_xfer WHERE xfer_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ), loans AS ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE io_cd='IN'),0) AS incoming, COALESCE(sum(amt) FILTER(WHERE io_cd='OUT'),0) AS outgoing FROM tb_fi_loan WHERE loan_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ), payments AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN p.pay_yn='Y' THEN p.pay_amt WHEN p.pay_amt IS NOT NULL THEN p.pay_amt WHEN p.pay_type_cd='MID' THEN 0 WHEN t.est_tax_amt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0,t.est_tax_amt-COALESCE(mid.pay_amt,0)) END AS amount FROM tb_fi_tax_pay p LEFT JOIN tb_fi_corp_tax t ON t.tax_yr=p.tax_yr LEFT JOIN tb_fi_tax_pay mid ON mid.tax_yr=p.tax_yr AND mid.pay_type_cd='MID' WHERE (p.pay_yn='Y' AND p.pay_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) OR (p.pay_yn='N' AND p.pay_due_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) ) SELECT i.sga AS "sgaAmount",i.sga_vat AS "sgaVatAmount",i.income AS "nonOperatingIncome", i.income_vat AS "nonOperatingIncomeVat",i.expense AS "nonOperatingExpense",i.expense_vat AS "nonOperatingExpenseVat", (SELECT COALESCE(sum(adj_amt),0) FROM tb_co_prev_adj WHERE aply_ym=#{databaseMonth}) AS "adjustmentProfit", i.cash_expense AS "cashFinancialExpense",i.cash_income AS "cashMiscIncome", (SELECT COALESCE(sum(cash_amt),0) FROM tb_fi_card_mon WHERE pay_ym=#{databaseMonth}) AS "cashCardExpense", x.expense AS "cashTransferExpense",x.labor AS "cashUnpaidLabor",x.total AS "transferTotal", l.incoming AS "cashLoanIn",l.outgoing AS "cashLoanOut", (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE amount IS NULL)>0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(sum(amount),0) END FROM payments) AS "cashTaxPayment" FROM items i CROSS JOIN transfers x CROSS JOIN loans l
SELECT est_tax_amt FROM tb_fi_corp_tax WHERE tax_yr=#{year}

SELECT to_char(m,'YYYYMM') AS "month",COALESCE(c.close_stat_cd,'WORK') AS "closeStatus",p.corp_tax_amt AS "amount" FROM generate_series(to_date(#{year} || '0101','YYYYMMDD'),to_date(#{year} || '1201','YYYYMMDD'),interval '1 month') m LEFT JOIN tb_cl_close c ON c.close_ym=to_char(m,'YYYYMM') LEFT JOIN tb_co_mon_pl p ON p.pl_ym=to_char(m,'YYYYMM') WHERE to_char(m,'YYYYMM') >= (SELECT trunc(std_val)::text FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m
mapper.sql:
WITH tax_keys AS ( SELECT tax_yr,pay_type_cd FROM tb_fi_tax_pay WHERE tax_yr=#{period.year} OR (tax_yr=#{period.priorYear} AND pay_type_cd='CNFM') OR (tax_yr < #{period.priorYear} AND pay_yn='N') ) SELECT h.* FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h WHERE
h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_CARD'
(h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_TAX_PAY' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tax_keys t WHERE h.trgt_key=t.tax_yr || ':' || t.pay_type_cd)) OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_CORP_TAX' AND (h.trgt_key=#{period.year} OR h.trgt_key IN (SELECT tax_yr FROM tax_keys)))
(h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_ITEM' AND split_part(h.trgt_key,':',1)=#{period.databaseMonth} AND h.trgt_key LIKE #{period.databaseMonth} || ':%') OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_CARD_MON' AND h.trgt_key=#{period.databaseMonth}) OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_CARD_PAY' AND split_part(h.trgt_key,':',1)=#{period.databaseMonth} AND h.trgt_key LIKE #{period.databaseMonth} || ':%') OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_CO_PREV_ADJ' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_co_prev_adj a WHERE a.adj_id::text=h.trgt_key AND a.aply_ym=#{period.databaseMonth}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_chg_hist a WHERE a.trgt_tbl_nm=h.trgt_tbl_nm AND a.trgt_key=h.trgt_key AND a.chg_item_nm='APLY_YM' AND (a.bfr_val=#{period.databaseMonth} OR a.aft_val=#{period.databaseMonth})))) OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_XFER' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_fi_xfer x WHERE x.xfer_sn::text=h.trgt_key AND x.xfer_dt BETWEEN #{period.start} AND #{period.end}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_chg_hist a WHERE a.trgt_tbl_nm=h.trgt_tbl_nm AND a.trgt_key=h.trgt_key AND a.chg_item_nm='XFER_DT' AND (left(a.bfr_val,7)=#{period.month} OR left(a.aft_val,7)=#{period.month})))) OR (h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_LOAN' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_fi_loan l WHERE l.loan_sn::text=h.trgt_key AND l.loan_dt BETWEEN #{period.start} AND #{period.end}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_chg_hist a WHERE a.trgt_tbl_nm=h.trgt_tbl_nm AND a.trgt_key=h.trgt_key AND a.chg_item_nm='LOAN_DT' AND (left(a.bfr_val,7)=#{period.month} OR left(a.aft_val,7)=#{period.month}))))
mapper.select: SELECT hist_id::text AS "historyId",trgt_tbl_nm AS "targetTable",trgt_key AS "targetKey",chg_type_cd AS "changeType", COALESCE(chg_item_nm,'') AS "field",bfr_val AS "beforeValue",aft_val AS "afterValue",chg_rsn AS "reason",reg_user_id AS "userId", to_char(reg_dttm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "occurredAt" FROM () filtered ORDER BY reg_dttm DESC,hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
